## Checklist

- [ ] Failing tests came first, in their own commit
- [ ] Small commits, each titled `test:`, `feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:`, `build:` or `ci:`
- [ ] Docs updated: `docs/language.md`, the design notes, `docs/errors.md`
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an "Unreleased" entry, or this PR has the `no-changelog` label
- [ ] No generated C, executables or build folders committed
